subject: Request: VP/CTO sync to clear blockers and schedule technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Pritchard <alex.pritchard@shopgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VP/CTO sync to clear blockers and schedule technical deep-dive

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap so we’re aligned:
- Goal: validate feasibility for a pilot that integrates ShopGrid search with a Redwood-hosted ranking pipeline.
- Main open items: security evidence (SOC2 scope + data flow), SLA/latency targets for the pilot, and pilot runbook/timeline.
- Internal ask: get a short VP/CTO handshake (30–45m) to unblock approvals and confirm engineering commitments.

To keep this light, would you and Nina be available for one of these windows next week?
1) Tue 2028-06-13 09:00–09:45 PT
2) Wed 2028-06-14 11:00–11:45 PT
3) Thu 2028-06-15 16:00–16:45 PT

Ben (SE) and Karthik (Solutions Architect) will join from our side to cover the runbook and quick infra questions. I’m attaching our discovery notes and a proposed runbook draft (stubs attached) — we’ll iterate the agenda once you confirm who will join from ShopGrid.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), proposed-runbook.xlsx (draft schedule + checklist)

If those windows don’t work, send two that do and we’ll accommodate. Short agenda we propose: 1) 10m context/goal, 2) 20–25m tech runbook + blockers, 3) 5–10m action items and next steps.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Alex Pritchard <alex.pritchard@shopgrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@shopgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VP/CTO sync to clear blockers and schedule technical deep-dive

Priya —

Appreciate the recap and the clear next steps. Nina (CTO) and Marcus (VP Engineering) are the right senior stakeholders for the handshake — I’ll add them to the invite once we settle time. Samantha (copied) is our Head of Ops and will coordinate logistics + security triage.

Our immediate asks from the Redwood side so we can prep the right folks:
- Short list of SOC2 artifacts or a one-page summary of controls you’ll share in the meeting.
- Example p95 latency for a 1k-token end-to-end request and any baseline token throughput numbers (tokens/sec) you’ve seen in similar pilots.

From the slots you sent, Tue 6/13 at 09:00 PT and Wed 6/14 at 11:00 PT both look promising — we prefer the Wednesday 11:00 PT window if that’s still open. If needed, Marcus can do Thu 6/15 afternoon as a backup.

We’ll plan to invite: Nina Patel (CTO), Marcus Dale (VP Eng), Samantha Li (Head of Ops), and our security lead (TBD).

On the attachments — I see the runbook stub and will review, thanks.

Best,
Alex
Alex Pritchard | Head of Platform Partnerships | ShopGrid
alex.pritchard@shopgrid.com | +1 (212) 555-0122

Thanks Alex — Wednesday 6/14 11:00 PT works on our side and we’ll block 45 minutes to give enough time for the runbook review.

Attendees from Redwood: Priya Natarajan (AE), Ben Carter (SE), Karthik Iyer (Solutions Architect).
Suggested high-level agenda (45m):
- 5m: Introductions & goals
- 25m: Technical runbook walkthrough (integration points, data flow, latency expectations)
- 10m: Security checklist / SOC2 artifact Qs
- 5m: Action items & timeline (pilot kickoff target and responsibilities)

Quick answers to the asks you flagged:
- SOC2 summary: we’ll attach a one-page evidence matrix before the meeting and bring our security engineer if deeper questions arise.
- Latency/throughput: for a similarly scoped e-commerce ranking pilot our p95 was ~280–320ms end-to-end for 1k-token requests on the reserved configuration we recommend; throughput depends on batching but we typically see 40–60 tokens/s per GPU core in real traffic patterns — we’ll include a short reference table in the one-pager.

I’ll update the runbook with a concise agenda and send the calendar invite once you confirm the final attendee list from your side. If Marcus prefers a shorter 30m handshake (VP-only) we can compress the runbook section.

Attachments: updated-runbook-stub.xlsx (will share a drive link ahead of the call)

— Priya
